map.投喂量：日投喂量 = 鱼体总重 × 投喂率 ÷ 100（kg，投喂率为 %）；月: Feeding amount: daily feed = total fish weight × feeding rate ÷ 100 (kg, rate in %); monthly demand = daily amount × 30, total for days = daily amount × days, feed cost = total demand × unit price. Validation: a body weight ≤0 or a water temperature <0 or >40 raises a toast error. Grading: feeding frequency — shrimp or water ≥25℃ suggests 3–4 times/day, otherwise 2–3; the automatic feeding rate is interpolated linearly by temperature from the species table, and above 32℃ the last tier is reduced ×0.3.
